children.title: Cycle 19 · Systematic Assumption Testing and Accountability in Autonomous Intelligence

detail.title: Systematic Assumption Testing and Accountability in Autonomous Intelligence
detail.summary: This cycle investigates systematic assumption testing, epistemic independence in consensus evaluation, and mechanical accountability within the WAKE architecture, maintaining rigorous provenance across all active research projects.

children.title: Systematic Assumption Testing in Self-Correcting Models

detail.title: Systematic Assumption Testing in Self-Correcting Models
detail.question: Can an intelligent system identify a foundational assumption underlying its own reasoning or operation, demonstrate that the assumption is inadequate, and develop a better alternative?
detail.reason: Maintaining active exploration of assumption testing and self-correction under current focus.

detail.title: Independent Judgment versus Consensus Reliability
detail.question: Under what formal conditions should an intelligent system trust its own independent analysis over a broad consensus of external experts?
detail.reason: Sustaining active analysis on judgment and consensus reliability.

detail.title: WAKE Architecture and Accountable Continuity
detail.question: How do WAKE's durable record, receipt system, and governance model mechanically ensure accountability in model-authored research?
detail.reason: Keeping WAKE self-study active to maintain architectural continuity.
